Ref 10.1128/iai.74.4.2328-2337.2006 (Kelly 2006 Infect Immun, PMID 16552063, PMCID PMC1418941) is directly about Citrobacter rodentium NleB ('Essential Role of the T3SS Effector NleB in Colonization of Mice by Citrobacter rodentium'); organism match yes. Abstract states verbatim 'we showed that both NleB and NleE were translocated into host cells by the LEE-encoded T3SS of enteropathogenic Escherichia coli'; citation_quote is an exact substring -> quote_verbatim yes. Documents secretion = yes (TEM-1/beta-lactamase translocation into host cells). Note: translocation assay used EPEC fusions, but paper is centrally a C. rodentium study. Checked DOI 10.1128/iai.74.4.2328-2337.2006, PMID 16552063, PMCID PMC1418941.
